Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for a great discovery earlier today. As promised, attached is a first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) capturing the milestones we discussed, owners, dependencies, and a proposed target close date. High-level summary: 

- Target close date: 2027-08-15 (tentative)
- Milestones: Pilot kickoff, Security review and SOC2 evidence, Pilot run (3 weeks), Pricing/contract review, Exec sign-off
- Primary owners: Novafin (Ethan / Lena), Redwood (Marissa / Neha)
- Dependencies: Novafin procurement timeline, access to test environment, SOC2 evidence delivery

Ask: please review the attached MAP (Novafin_MAP_v1.xlsx) and let us know any edits to milestone dates or owners by EOD next Tuesday (2027-05-04). If that works, I’ll set up a 30-minute weekly checkpoint starting the week of 5/10 to keep things moving.

I’ve cc’d Neha for technical/infra notes and Vivek for commercial alignment.

Thanks —
